limitations: Idle CPU/RSS and bounded synthetic reducer regression checks do not measure queue latency, UI frames/GPU, live Discord interoperability, or physical media performance. No live account, service call, microphone, camera or OS picker was used. Tiny differences are noise; no improvement claim.

historical_pre_watch_bounds: Confirmation failure carries a channel ID, two u64 values, and a fixed static diagnostic through the existing bounded event queue. No allocated payload, pending retry slot, new cache or worker is added; original 30-second negotiation deadline unchanged.

current_watch_correction.bounds: One optional fixed Copy report containing generation/channel/request/revision and static diagnostic, at most 64 bytes plus fixed watch synchronization metadata. No allocated payload or credentials, account-event item/byte usage, retry worker or new command slot. Report stays unseen until reliable FIFO drains; closed-publisher report delivered exactly once; original 30-second deadline unchanged.
